table_description: Fact table recording every item returned from catalog channel orders. Each row is one returned line item. At SF100TCL scale contains approximately 16 billion rows. Like CATALOG_SALES, it tracks both the refunded customer and the returning customer, which can differ.
use_cases: Return reason tracking for catalog orders
Refund method analysis (cash vs store credit vs charge reversal)
Return-to-sales ratio by item, category, or call center
Warehouse and shipping mode impact on returns
data_quality_notes: CR_REFUNDED_CUSTOMER_SK is who gets the refund; CR_RETURNING_CUSTOMER_SK is who physically returns the item — they can differ.
CR_ORDER_NUMBER links to CATALOG_SALES.CS_ORDER_NUMBER for return-to-sale matching.
CR_NET_LOSS is the financial loss metric — includes refunded amounts minus any fees recovered.
Refund can go to CR_REFUNDED_CASH, CR_REVERSED_CHARGE, or CR_STORE_CREDIT — these are not mutually exclusive, sum them for total refund.

table_columns.name: CR_RETURNED_DATE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to DATE_DIM. Return date. Can be NULL.

table_columns.name: CR_RETURNED_TIME_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to TIME_DIM. Return time.

table_columns.name: CR_ITEM_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to ITEM. Part of composite primary key with CR_ORDER_NUMBER.

table_columns.name: CR_REFUNDED_CUSTOMER_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER. Customer receiving the refund.

table_columns.name: CR_REFUNDED_CDEMO_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER_DEMOGRAPHICS. Demographics of refunded customer.

table_columns.name: CR_REFUNDED_ADDR_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER_ADDRESS. Address of refunded customer.

table_columns.name: CR_RETURNING_CUSTOMER_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CUSTOMER. Customer physically returning the item. May differ from refunded customer.

table_columns.name: CR_CALL_CENTER_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CALL_CENTER. Call center handling the return.

table_columns.name: CR_CATALOG_PAGE_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to CATALOG_PAGE. Page the original purchase was on.

table_columns.name: CR_REASON_SK
table_columns.description: Foreign key to REASON. Why the item was returned.

table_columns.name: CR_ORDER_NUMBER
table_columns.description: Original order number. Links to CATALOG_SALES.CS_ORDER_NUMBER.

table_columns.name: CR_NET_LOSS
table_columns.description: Net financial loss to retailer from this return.
